{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))
print("QA order IDs:", qa_orders['order_id'].tolist())

# Check if any of these are in the converted group
print("QA orders with converted == 1:", qa_orders[qa_orders['converted'] == 1])"}
